title: Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump
model_title: Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump (Priming Chamber, Flap Valve)

introduction.definition: A self-priming centrifugal pump can evacuate air from its suction line by itself once the casing has been filled. A priming chamber above the impeller retains liquid; during priming the impeller mixes it with air, the air separates in the chamber and escapes through the discharge, and the liquid recirculates until the suction line is full.
applications: Pumping from pits and tanks below the pump (suction lift)
Wastewater and slurry transfer with solids
key_points: Needs liquid in the casing for the first start
Suction lift up to about 7 m (practical 4–7.5 m)
Flap valve keeps the casing full
Air must escape from the discharge
introduction.summary: A centrifugal pump that can re-prime itself from a dry suction line once its casing holds liquid. During priming the impeller whips the retained liquid and the air drawn from the suction line into a froth; in the chamber above the volute the air separates and escapes through the discharge, while the liquid falls back (recirculation port) to be reused. When the suction line is evacuated, the pump runs as a normal centrifugal pump. The flap valve keeps liquid in the casing when the pump stops.

steps.text: The casing is filled with liquid before the first start; the flap valve keeps it there.
The impeller whips the retained liquid and air from the suction line into a froth.
In the priming chamber the air separates and leaves through the discharge.
The separated liquid returns through the recirculation port to the impeller.
When all air is removed the pump runs as a normal centrifugal pump.

video_tutorials.title: Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump.
A self-priming centrifugal pump can evacuate air from its suction line by itself once the casing has been filled.

A priming chamber above the impeller retains liquid; during priming the impeller mixes it with air, the air separates in the chamber and escapes through the discharge, and the liquid recirculates until the suction line is full.
Typical applications include construction dewatering; pumping from pits and tanks below the pump (suction lift); wastewater and slurry transfer with solids; marine bilge and ballast.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Casing with Priming Chamber, Semi-Open Impeller (3-vane, solids-handling), Replaceable Wear Plate, Casing Cover & Seal Chamber.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump works.
The casing is filled with liquid before the first start; the flap valve keeps it there.
The impeller whips the retained liquid and air from the suction line into a froth.
In the priming chamber the air separates and leaves through the discharge.
The separated liquid returns through the recirculation port to the impeller.
When all air is removed the pump runs as a normal centrifugal pump.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Self-Priming Centrifugal Pump.
Check priming liquid level and flap valve.
Check and reset wear-plate clearance.
Replace impeller, wear plate and seal.
Watch for will not prime: long priming time, no flow. Common cause: suction air leaks.
Watch for overheating during priming: hot casing. Common cause: long priming with little liquid.
Watch for wear-plate wear: lower head and longer priming. Common cause: abrasives.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.

questions.question: What must be in the casing before a self-priming pump is first started?
questions.explanation: It needs liquid to create the air–liquid mixture.

questions.question: Where does the air from the suction line leave the pump?
questions.explanation: Air separates in the chamber and exits via the discharge.

questions.question: A worn wear plate causes…
